items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Could you just pick that up yourself? And Kid Renee.

ctx.x: Well, I happened to find a good one in the... in a pawn shop, you see. That's why. I used that helicon bass. I played with Clayton. Kid Clayton.
Could you just pick that up yourself? And Kid Renee.
No, I went under professor with the bass horn. The bass horn.
